summary: South Cotabato 1st District representative with 53 principal-authored bills, mostly local administrative measures. Co-authored the national minimum wage and travel-tax abolition only. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
